artistBio: Maya Rivers is a fictional sample artist created to demonstrate this template. She paints luminous semi-abstract landscapes where water meets architecture — dawn harbors dissolving into gold, city grids breaking into rhythm. Replace this bio with your own story: where you work, what you paint, and what drives the work.
